projectDescription: A Python library for building hierarchical multi-agent systems where specialized agents are orchestrated by a central supervisor agent using LangGraph.
keyFeatures: Create supervisor agents to orchestrate multiple specialized sub-agents
Tool-based agent handoff mechanism for seamless communication between agents
Flexible message history management with full_history and last_message output modes
Multi-level hierarchical agent systems (supervisors of supervisors)
Built-in support for short-term and long-term memory via LangGraph checkpointers and stores
Customizable handoff tools with custom names, descriptions, and arguments
Message forwarding tool to pass worker responses directly to output without paraphrasing
Inline agent name mode for non-OpenAI/Anthropic LLM providers
Support for both Graph API and Functional API agent workflows
Parallel tool call control for multi-agent handoffs
publicApiSurface: create_supervisor(agents, *, model, tools, prompt, response_format, pre_model_hook, post_model_hook, parallel_tool_calls, state_schema, context_schema, output_mode, add_handoff_messages, handoff_tool_prefix, add_handoff_back_messages, supervisor_name, include_agent_name)
